title: Axon Control Plane — stop semantics
description: Four distinct stops, each honest about its boundary (arch §13). The emergency result is a per-component ack map: all_stopped is true ONLY if every registered component acknowledged (confirmed_stopped) or is provably_gone. Any 'unreachable' component forces all_stopped=false. Never fakes successful cancellation.

stopScope.description: pause_axon: finish/abort current beat at the atomic runtime boundary (Heart host BeatState idle). stop_training: stop at a recoverable Trainer tranche boundary (mid-segment interactive pause is a FUTURE organ handler; until wired the organ returns UNAVAILABLE and the ack says so). stop_compute: terminate a selected worker/provider job (only when the provider advertises supportsStop). emergency: attempt to halt organism execution + training immediately with full ack accounting.

detail.description: Verbatim upstream answer where applicable, e.g. Trainer UNAVAILABLE message.

target.description: Required for stop_compute (worker id); optional elsewhere.

all_stopped.description: HONEST accounting (arch §13): true ONLY when every registered component acked confirmed_stopped or provably_gone. The server MUST NOT set this true while any component is unreachable.
